name: sugatoray
description: Sugato Ray's curated agent skills, as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: scrolls-skills
plugins.description: Scrolls: a git-native markdown system for agentic memory that persists project state across sessions and agents (/scrolls-setup, /scrolls-update, /scrolls-hide, /scrolls-unhide, /scrolls-help).

plugins.name: stata-skills
plugins.description: Stata skills: turns a plain-language data/statistics task into correct, runnable Stata code, with good-vs-bad command guidance, Python↔Stata interop, and a growing recipe library (ARDL, time-series and panel regression, unit-root tests).

plugins.name: repo-related-skills
plugins.description: Repo-related skills: acting on a repository's own hosted state (issues, pull requests, releases, and similar). Files GitHub issue(s) for a PR's work and keeps the PR's title/description in sync with them.

plugins.name: personal-branding-skills
plugins.description: Personal-branding skills: researches a named person from public sources and builds a tasteful, sourced, self-contained personal landing page from a reviewable YAML data file.
